text:
alex: Heads-up: spotted some broken anchors and two flaky shortlinks in the runtime KB while prepping a runbook update. Can someone triage when you have a minute? Not blocking but would be great to tidy before next deploy.

maria: I can look in ~20m. Which pages?

alex: content/kb/runtime/kv-cache.md and content/runbooks/kv-cache-operational.md the Troubleshooting > Prefix cache miss anchor seems off.

joel: quick rg shows the anchor text is present in both files but one has a trailing punctuation char (period) which breaks the internal anchor resolution in the site:

joel: ```
rg "prefix-cache-miss" -n content | sed -n '1,5p'
content/kb/runtime/kv-cache.md:142:#prefix-cache-miss
content/runbooks/kv-cache-operational.md:57:#prefix-cache-miss.
```

docs-bot: link-scan: 2 broken anchors detected in /kb/runtime. Created ticket KB-4321 https://tracker.internal/KB-4321

samantha: I can prep a small PR to normalize anchors (strip trailing punctuation) and update any href refs. Want me to include shortlink redirects for the old short.red urls?

maria: Yes please. There are shortlinks short.red/kv and short.red/kv-runbook that currently 302 to S3 and occasionally 403 in staging. Replace with canonical paths + add redirects in the shortlink service config. I'll validate in staging preview.

alex: Makes sense. If you do the PR, add @joel for review and include a one-line changelog note so ops is aware of the redirect.

maria: Will do. I'll run a grep for punctuation trailing anchors to catch any other instances.

maria: ```
# find anchors with trailing punctuation
rg "href=.*#.*[\.|,|;|)]" -n content | sed -n '1,50p'
```

maria: Found 3 matches total across kb + runbooks. I'll fix them all and update the referring links.

joel: After you merge, ping me and I can trigger a reindex of staging so previews pick up the anchor changes.

samantha: tiny suggestion: use commit message format: "docs(kb): normalize anchors; migrate shortlinks" so it's easy to track.

alex: Thanks team  assigning ownership to @maria. No rush  target EOD.

maria: PR will include changelog entry, redirect config diff, and test notes for staging validation.

alex: Great, closing the loop. :thumbsup:
